1.w: In You, O YHWH, I take refuge; let me not be put to shame forever!

2.w: In Your righteousness, deliver me and cause me to escape; incline to me Your ear, and save me!

3.w: May You be to me as a rock, a habitation, to go in continually; You have given a command to save me, for You [are] my rock and my fortress.

4.w: O My God, rescue me from the hand of a wicked one, from the palm of the one acting unjustly and pressing.

5.w: For You [are] my hope, O Lord YHWH, my trust from my youth.

6.w: By You I have been supported from the womb; from the bowels of my mother You cut me out. My praise [is] continually for You.

7.w: I have been as a wonder to many, and You [are] my strong refuge.

8.w: My mouth is filled [with] Your praise, [with] Your splendor all the day.

9.w: Do not cast me off in the time of old age; according to the consumption of my strength do not forsake me.

10.w: For my enemies speak against me, and those watching my soul take counsel together,

11.w: saying, “God has forsaken him. Pursue him and seize him, for [there is] none to deliver [him]!”

12.w: O God, do not be far from me; O my God, hurry to [be] my help!

13.w: Let them be put to shame [and] consumed, those opposing my soul; let them be covered [with] scorn and disgrace, those seeking my harm!

14.w: But I continually will hope, and I will add upon all Your praise.

15.w: My mouth will recount Your righteousness, all the day Your salvation, though I do not know the numbers.

16.w: I will come in the might of the Lord YHWH; I will cause Your righteousness to be remembered—Yours alone.

17.w: O God, You have taught me from my youth, and until now I declare Your wonders.

18.w: Indeed, when [I am] old and grayheaded, O God, do not forsake me, until I declare Your arm to a generation, Your strength to everyone to come.

19.w: And Your righteousness, O God, [is] to the height! [You] who have done great things, O God—who [is] like You?

20.w: Though You have made me see many troubles and distresses, You will return [and] revive us; even from the depths of the earth, You will return [and] bring me up.

21.w: You will increase my honor, and surrounding [me], You will comfort me.

22.w: I will also praise You with the harp [for] Your faithfulness, O my God; I will make music to You with the lyre, O Holy One of Israel!

23.w: My lips will shout for joy when when I sing praises to You, even my soul, which You have redeemed.

24.w: My tongue will also utter Your righteousness all the day, for they have been put to shame, for they are humiliated—those seeking my harm.
